verses.original: כִּי֩ יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽת־ יְרַחֵ֨ם יַעֲקֹ֗ב עוֹד֙ וּבָחַ֥ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהִנִּיחָ֖ם עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֑ם הַגֵּר֙ וְנִלְוָ֤ה וְנִסְפְּח֖וּ עַל־ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם בֵּ֥ית יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh ’eṯ- yə·ra·ḥêm ya·‘ă·qōḇ ‘ō·wḏ ū·ḇā·ḥar bə·yiś·rā·’êl wə·hin·nî·ḥām ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām hag·gêr wə·nil·wāh wə·nis·pə·ḥū ‘al- ‘ă·lê·hem bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: For the LORD - will have compassion on Jacob once again He will choose Israel and settle them in their own land The foreigner will join them and unite . . . with the house of Jacob

verses.original: עַמִּים֮ וּלְקָח֣וּם וֶהֱבִיא֣וּם אֶל־ מְקוֹמָם֒ בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְהִֽתְנַחֲל֣וּם לַעֲבָדִ֖ים וְלִשְׁפָח֑וֹת עַ֚ל יְהוָ֔ה אַדְמַ֣ת וְהָיוּ֙ שֹׁבִ֣ים לְשֹֽׁבֵיהֶ֔ם וְרָד֖וּ בְּנֹגְשֵׂיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mîm ū·lə·qā·ḥūm we·hĕ·ḇî·’ūm ’el- mə·qō·w·mām bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·hiṯ·na·ḥă·lūm la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wə·liš·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ ‘al Yah·weh ’aḏ·maṯ wə·hā·yū šō·ḇîm lə·šō·ḇê·hem wə·rā·ḏū bə·nō·ḡə·śê·hem
verses.literal: The nations will escort [Israel] and bring it to its homeland Then the house of Israel will possess [the nations] as menservants and maidservants in the LORD’s land They will make captives of their captors and rule over their oppressors

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּי֨וֹם יְהוָה֙ הָנִ֤יחַ לְךָ֔ וּמִן־ מֵֽעָצְבְּךָ֖ וּמֵרָגְזֶ֑ךָ הַקָּשָׁ֖ה הָעֲבֹדָ֥ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֻבַּד־ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·yō·wm Yah·weh hā·nî·aḥ lə·ḵā ū·min- mê·‘ā·ṣə·bə·ḵā ū·mê·rā·ḡə·ze·ḵā haq·qā·šāh hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh ’ă·šer ‘ub·baḏ- bāḵ
verses.literal: - On the day that the LORD gives you rest . . . from your pain and torment and from the hard labor into which you were forced

verses.original: וְנָשָׂ֜אתָ הַזֶּ֛ה הַמָּשָׁ֥ל עַל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְאָמָ֑רְתָּ אֵ֚יךְ נֹגֵ֔שׂ שָׁבַ֣ת מַדְהֵבָֽה׃ שָׁבְתָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·śā·ṯā haz·zeh ham·mā·šāl ‘al- me·leḵ bā·ḇel wə·’ā·mā·rə·tā ’êḵ nō·ḡêś šā·ḇaṯ maḏ·hê·ḇāh šā·ḇə·ṯāh
verses.literal: you will sing this song of contempt against the king of Babylon - How the oppressor has ceased and how his fury has ended

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה שָׁבַ֥ר מַטֵּ֣ה רְשָׁעִ֑ים שֵׁ֖בֶט מֹשְׁלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh šā·ḇar maṭ·ṭêh rə·šā·‘îm šê·ḇeṭ mō·šə·lîm
verses.literal: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked the scepter of the rulers

verses.original: מַכֶּ֤ה עַמִּים֙ בְּעֶבְרָ֔ה בִּלְתִּ֣י סָרָ֑ה מַכַּ֖ת רֹדֶ֤ה גּוֹיִ֔ם בָאַף֙ בְּלִ֥י חָשָֽׂךְ׃ מֻרְדָּ֖ף
verses.transliteration: mak·keh ‘am·mîm bə·‘eḇ·rāh bil·tî sā·rāh mak·kaṯ rō·ḏeh gō·w·yim ḇā·’ap̄ bə·lî ḥā·śāḵ mur·dāp̄
verses.literal: It struck the peoples in anger with unceasing . . . blows it subdued the nations in rage with relentless . . . persecution

verses.original: כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ שָׁקְטָ֖ה נָ֥חָה פָּצְח֖וּ רִנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ šā·qə·ṭāh nā·ḥāh pā·ṣə·ḥū rin·nāh
verses.literal: All the earth is at peace and at rest they break out in song

verses.original: גַּם־ בְּרוֹשִׁ֛ים אַרְזֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן שָׂמְח֥וּ לְךָ֖ מֵאָ֣ז שָׁכַ֔בְתָּ לֹֽא־ הַכֹּרֵ֖ת יַעֲלֶ֥ה עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: gam- bə·rō·wō·šîm ’ar·zê lə·ḇā·nō·wn śā·mə·ḥū lə·ḵā mê·’āz šā·ḵaḇ·tā lō- hak·kō·rêṯ ya·‘ă·leh ‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: Even the cypresses and cedars of Lebanon exult over you Since you have been laid low no woodcutter comes against us

verses.original: שְׁא֗וֹל מִתַּ֛חַת רָגְזָ֥ה לִקְרַ֣את לְךָ֖ בּוֹאֶ֑ךָ עוֹרֵ֨ר רְפָאִים֙ לְךָ֤ כָּל־ עַתּ֣וּדֵי אָ֔רֶץ כֹּ֖ל מַלְכֵ֥י גוֹיִֽם׃ הֵקִים֙ מִכִּסְאוֹתָ֔ם
verses.transliteration: šə·’ō·wl mit·ta·ḥaṯ rā·ḡə·zāh liq·raṯ lə·ḵā bō·w·’e·ḵā ‘ō·w·rêr rə·p̄ā·’îm lə·ḵā kāl- ‘at·tū·ḏê ’ā·reṣ kōl mal·ḵê ḡō·w·yim hê·qîm mik·kis·’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Sheol beneath is eager to meet you upon your arrival It stirs the spirits of the dead to greet you all the rulers of the earth It makes all the kings of the nations rise from their thrones

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֣ם יַֽעֲנ֔וּ אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְיֹאמְר֖וּ אַתָּ֛ה גַּם־ חֻלֵּ֥יתָ כָמ֖וֹנוּ אֵלֵ֥ינוּ נִמְשָֽׁלְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām ya·‘ă·nū ’ê·le·ḵā wə·yō·mə·rū ’at·tāh gam- ḥul·lê·ṯā ḵā·mō·w·nū ’ê·lê·nū nim·šā·lə·tā
verses.literal: They will all respond to you saying You too have become weak as we are you have become like us

verses.original: גְּאוֹנֶ֖ךָ הוּרַ֥ד שְׁא֛וֹל הֶמְיַ֣ת נְבָלֶ֑יךָ רִמָּ֔ה יֻצַּ֣ע תַּחְתֶּ֙יךָ֙ תּוֹלֵעָֽה׃ וּמְכַסֶּ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: ḡə·’ō·w·ne·ḵā hū·raḏ šə·’ō·wl hem·yaṯ nə·ḇā·le·ḵā rim·māh yuṣ·ṣa‘ taḥ·te·ḵā tō·w·lê·‘āh ū·mə·ḵas·se·ḵā
verses.literal: Your pomp has been brought down to Sheol along with the music of your harps Maggots are your bed . . . and worms your blanket

verses.original: אֵ֛יךְ נָפַ֥לְתָּ מִשָּׁמַ֖יִם הֵילֵ֣ל בֶּן־ שָׁ֑חַר נִגְדַּ֣עְתָּ לָאָ֔רֶץ חוֹלֵ֖שׁ עַל־ גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ nā·p̄al·tā miš·šā·ma·yim hê·lêl ben- šā·ḥar niḡ·da‘·tā lā·’ā·reṣ ḥō·w·lêš ‘al- gō·w·yim
verses.literal: How you have fallen from heaven O day star son of the dawn You have been cut down to the ground O destroyer of nations

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אָמַ֤רְתָּ בִֽלְבָבְךָ֙ אֶֽעֱלֶ֔ה הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אָרִ֣ים כִּסְאִ֑י מִמַּ֥עַל לְכֽוֹכְבֵי־ אֵ֖ל וְאֵשֵׁ֥ב בְּהַר־ מוֹעֵ֖ד בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֥י צָפֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’ā·mar·tā ḇil·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ’e·‘ĕ·leh haš·šā·ma·yim ’ā·rîm kis·’î mim·ma·‘al lə·ḵō·wḵ·ḇê- ’êl wə·’ê·šêḇ bə·har- mō·w·‘êḏ bə·yar·kə·ṯê ṣā·p̄ō·wn
verses.literal: You said in your heart I will ascend to the heavens I will raise my throne above the stars of God I will sit on the mount of assembly in the far reaches of the north

verses.original: אֶעֱלֶ֖ה עַל־ בָּ֣מֳתֵי עָ֑ב אֶדַּמֶּ֖ה לְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·‘ĕ·leh ‘al- bā·mo·ṯê ‘āḇ ’ed·dam·meh lə·‘el·yō·wn
verses.literal: I will ascend above the tops of the clouds I will make myself like the Most High

verses.original: אַ֧ךְ תּוּרָ֖ד אֶל־ שְׁא֛וֹל אֶל־ יַרְכְּתֵי־ בֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ tū·rāḏ ’el- šə·’ō·wl ’el- yar·kə·ṯê- ḇō·wr
verses.literal: But you will be brought down to Sheol to the lowest depths of the Pit

verses.original: רֹאֶ֙יךָ֙ יַשְׁגִּ֔יחוּ אֵלֶ֣יךָ יִתְבּוֹנָ֑נוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ הֲזֶ֤ה הָאִישׁ֙ מַרְגִּ֣יז הָאָ֔רֶץ מַמְלָכֽוֹת׃ מַרְעִ֖ישׁ
verses.transliteration: rō·’e·ḵā yaš·gî·ḥū ’ê·le·ḵā yiṯ·bō·w·nā·nū ’ê·le·ḵā hă·zeh hā·’îš mar·gîz hā·’ā·reṣ mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ mar·‘îš
verses.literal: Those who see you will stare - they will ponder your fate Is this the man who shook the earth [and] made the kingdoms tremble

verses.original: שָׂ֥ם תֵּבֵ֛ל כַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר הָרָ֑ס וְעָרָ֣יו לֹא־ פָ֥תַח אֲסִירָ֖יו בָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.transliteration: śām tê·ḇêl kam·miḏ·bār hā·rās wə·‘ā·rāw lō- p̄ā·ṯaḥ ’ă·sî·rāw bā·yə·ṯāh
verses.literal: who turned the world into a desert and destroyed its cities who refused to let the captives return to their homes

verses.original: כָּל־ מַלְכֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑ם שָׁכְב֥וּ בְכָב֖וֹד אִ֥ישׁ בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- mal·ḵê ḡō·w·yim kul·lām šā·ḵə·ḇū ḇə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ’îš bə·ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: All the kings of the nations . . . lie in state each in his own tomb

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה הָשְׁלַ֤כְתָּ מִֽקִּבְרְךָ֙ נִתְעָ֔ב כְּנֵ֣צֶר לְב֥וּשׁ הֲרֻגִ֖ים מְטֹ֣עֲנֵי חָ֑רֶב יוֹרְדֵ֥י אֶל־ אַבְנֵי־ ב֖וֹר כְּפֶ֥גֶר מוּבָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh hā·šə·laḵ·tā miq·qiḇ·rə·ḵā niṯ·‘āḇ kə·nê·ṣer lə·ḇūš hă·ru·ḡîm mə·ṭō·‘ă·nê ḥā·reḇ yō·wr·ḏê ’el- ’aḇ·nê- ḇō·wr kə·p̄e·ḡer mū·ḇās
verses.literal: But you are cast out of your grave like a rejected branch covered by those slain . . . with the sword and dumped into a rocky pit like a carcass trampled underfoot

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תֵחַ֤ד אִתָּם֙ בִּקְבוּרָ֔ה כִּֽי־ שִׁחַ֖תָּ אַרְצְךָ֥ הָרָ֑גְתָּ עַמְּךָ֣ זֶ֥רַע מְרֵעִֽים׃ לֹֽא־ לְעוֹלָ֖ם יִקָּרֵ֥א
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯê·ḥaḏ ’it·tām biq·ḇū·rāh kî- ši·ḥa·tā ’ar·ṣə·ḵā hā·rā·ḡə·tā ‘am·mə·ḵā ze·ra‘ mə·rê·‘îm lō- lə·‘ō·w·lām yiq·qā·rê
verses.literal: You will not join them . . . in burial since you have destroyed your land and slaughtered your own people The offspring of the wicked will never again . . . be mentioned

verses.original: הָכִ֧ינוּ מַטְבֵּ֖חַ לְבָנָ֛יו בַּעֲוֺ֣ן אֲבוֹתָ֑ם בַּל־ יָקֻ֙מוּ֙ וְיָ֣רְשׁוּ אָ֔רֶץ פְנֵֽי־ תֵבֵ֖ל וּמָלְא֥וּ עָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḵî·nū maṭ·bê·aḥ lə·ḇā·nāw ba·‘ă·wōn ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām bal- yā·qu·mū wə·yā·rə·šū ’ā·reṣ p̄ə·nê- ṯê·ḇêl ū·mā·lə·’ū ‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: Prepare a place to slaughter his sons for the iniquities of their forefathers They will never rise up to possess a land or cover the earth with their cities

verses.original: וְקַמְתִּ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְהִכְרַתִּ֨י לְבָבֶ֜ל שֵׁ֥ם וּשְׁאָ֛ר וְנִ֥ין וָנֶ֖כֶד נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qam·tî ‘ă·lê·hem nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·hiḵ·rat·tî lə·ḇā·ḇel šêm ū·šə·’ār wə·nîn wā·ne·ḵeḏ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will rise up against them declares the LORD of Hosts I will cut off from Babylon her name and her remnant her offspring and her posterity declares the LORD

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֛יהָ לְמוֹרַ֥שׁ קִפֹּ֖ד וְאַגְמֵי־ מָ֑יִם וְטֵֽאטֵאתִ֙יהָ֙ בְּמַטְאֲטֵ֣א הַשְׁמֵ֔ד נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî·hā lə·mō·w·raš qip·pōḏ wə·’aḡ·mê- mā·yim wə·ṭê·ṭê·ṯî·hā bə·maṭ·’ă·ṭê haš·mêḏ nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will make her a place for owls and for swamplands . . . I will sweep her away with the broom of destruction declares the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר נִשְׁבַּ֛ע אִם־ לֹ֞א כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּמִּ֙יתִי֙ כֵּ֣ן הָיָ֔תָה וְכַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָעַ֖צְתִּי הִ֥יא תָקֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ lê·mōr niš·ba‘ ’im- lō ka·’ă·šer dim·mî·ṯî kên hā·yā·ṯāh wə·ḵa·’ă·šer yā·‘aṣ·tî hî ṯā·qūm
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts . . . has sworn Surely . . . as I have planned so will it be as I have purposed . . . [so] will it stand

verses.original: לִשְׁבֹּ֤ר אַשּׁוּר֙ בְּאַרְצִ֔י אֲבוּסֶ֑נּוּ וְעַל־ הָרַ֖י עֻלּ֔וֹ וְסָ֤ר מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְסֻ֨בֳּל֔וֹ יָסֽוּר׃ מֵעַ֥ל שִׁכְמ֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: liš·bōr ’aš·šūr bə·’ar·ṣî ’ă·ḇū·sen·nū wə·‘al- hā·ray ‘ul·lōw wə·sār mê·‘ă·lê·hem wə·sub·bo·lōw yā·sūr mê·‘al šiḵ·mōw
verses.literal: I will break Assyria in My land I will trample him on My mountain His yoke will be taken off [My people] and his burden removed from their shoulders

verses.original: זֹ֛את הָעֵצָ֥ה הַיְּעוּצָ֖ה עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְזֹ֛את הַיָּ֥ד הַנְּטוּיָ֖ה עַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ hā·‘ê·ṣāh hay·yə·‘ū·ṣāh ‘al- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·zōṯ hay·yāḏ han·nə·ṭū·yāh ‘al- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: This is the plan devised for the whole earth and this is the hand stretched out over all the nations

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת יָעָ֖ץ וּמִ֣י יָפֵ֑ר וְיָד֥וֹ הַנְּטוּיָ֖ה וּֽמִ֥י יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yā·‘āṣ ū·mî yā·p̄êr wə·yā·ḏōw han·nə·ṭū·yāh ū·mî yə·šî·ḇen·nāh
verses.literal: - The LORD of Hosts has purposed and who can thwart Him His hand is outstretched so who can turn it back

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַת־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָחָ֑ז מ֖וֹת הַזֶּֽה׃ הַמַּשָּׂ֥א הָיָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ- ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz mō·wṯ haz·zeh ham·maś·śā hā·yāh
verses.literal: In the year that King Ahaz died this burden was received

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י כֻּלֵּ֔ךְ פְלֶ֙שֶׁת֙ כִּ֥י שֵׁ֣בֶט מַכֵּ֑ךְ נִשְׁבַּ֖ר כִּֽי־ צֶ֔פַע יֵ֣צֵא מִשֹּׁ֤רֶשׁ נָחָשׁ֙ מְעוֹפֵֽף׃ שָׂרָ֥ף וּפִרְי֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiś·mə·ḥî kul·lêḵ p̄ə·le·šeṯ kî šê·ḇeṭ mak·kêḵ niš·bar kî- ṣe·p̄a‘ yê·ṣê miš·šō·reš nā·ḥāš mə·‘ō·w·p̄êp̄ śā·rāp̄ ū·p̄ir·yōw
verses.literal: Do not rejoice all you Philistines that the rod that struck you is broken For a viper will spring from the root of the snake and a flying serpent from its egg

verses.original: בְּכוֹרֵ֣י דַלִּ֔ים וְרָעוּ֙ וְאֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים יִרְבָּ֑צוּ לָבֶ֣טַח וְהֵמַתִּ֤י שָׁרְשֵׁ֔ךְ בָֽרָעָב֙ וּשְׁאֵרִיתֵ֖ךְ יַהֲרֹֽג׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵō·w·rê ḏal·lîm wə·rā·‘ū wə·’eḇ·yō·w·nîm yir·bā·ṣū lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ wə·hê·mat·tî šā·rə·šêḵ ḇā·rā·‘āḇ ū·šə·’ê·rî·ṯêḵ ya·hă·rōḡ
verses.literal: Then the firstborn of the poor will find pasture and the needy will lie down in safety but I will kill your root by famine and your remnant will be slain

verses.original: הֵילִ֤ילִֽי שַׁ֙עַר֙ זַֽעֲקִי־ עִ֔יר נָמ֖וֹג כֻּלֵּ֑ךְ פְּלֶ֣שֶׁת כִּ֤י עָשָׁ֣ן בָּ֔א מִצָּפוֹן֙ וְאֵ֥ין בּוֹדֵ֖ד בְּמוֹעָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hê·lî·lî ša·‘ar za·‘ă·qî- ‘îr nā·mō·wḡ kul·lêḵ pə·le·šeṯ kî ‘ā·šān bā miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·’ên bō·w·ḏêḏ bə·mō·w·‘ā·ḏāw
verses.literal: Wail O gate Cry out O city Melt away all you Philistines For a cloud of smoke comes from the north and there are no stragglers in its ranks

verses.original: וּמַֽה־ יַּעֲנֶ֖ה מַלְאֲכֵי־ ג֑וֹי כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ יִסַּ֣ד צִיּ֔וֹן וּבָ֥הּ עֲנִיֵּ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃ס יֶחֱס֖וּ
verses.transliteration: ū·mah- ya·‘ă·neh mal·’ă·ḵê- ḡō·w kî Yah·weh yis·saḏ ṣî·yō·wn ū·ḇāh ‘ă·nî·yê ‘am·mōw ye·ḥĕ·sū
verses.literal: What answer will be given to the envoys of that nation . . . The LORD has founded Zion where His afflicted people will find refuge
